item_skincare_cream_flavor: A sleek glass jar containing a shimmering serum.
item_skincare_cream_desc: A sought-after luxurious serum designed to rejuvenate and restore skin using ethically sourced stem cells.
item_box_tampon_flavor: Promising protection and discretion, sanitary products like these are a luxury that few in the Lower Levels can afford.
item_packet_red_cigarette_flavor: The most luxurious smoking experience one can have, with a flavor, and a price tag, that makes sure you remember it.
item_pack_condom_flavor: Surprisingly common in the Lower Levels thanks to a subsidised distribution program. Population control, after all, is cheaper than riot control.
item_shampoo_flavor: Shampoo, conditioner, body wash and toothpaste, all in one convenient bottle, with rejuvenating Nutrifruit extract.
item_toothpaste_flavor: A minty gel that promises fresh breath.
item_toilet_paper_flavor: Affordable toilet paper that offers strength and reliability. Two-ply is a luxury in the Lower Levels.
item_water_test_container_desc: A small bottle of color strips used to test water quality.
item_water_test_strip_desc: A testing strip used to accurately determine the quality of a water sample.
item_uv_filter_desc: Can be used on a water container.
item_uv_filter_flavor: A lamp that emits ultraviolet light to kill bacteria and other microorganisms.
item_aquascan_desc: A device used to accurately determine the quality of a water sample. Displays detected impurities.
item_metal_scanner_desc: A device that improves your chance of finding valuables when scavenging. (You can only benefit from one Scav Scanner at a time.)
item_metal_scanner_flavor: Ever wanted a third eye? Or a second nose? Cut through the clutter with a Scav Scanner!
item_water_tablet_container_desc: A small bottle of tablets used to purify water.
item_water_tablet_desc: Eliminate large amount of microbial contaminants and partially reduce chemical contaminants. No effect against other types of contaminants.
item_hydroponic_nutrient_tablet_desc: Contains minerals that are essential for plant growth. Can be added to a water container.
item_hydroponic_nutrient_tablet_flavor: Do Not Consume. For hydroponic use only.
item_nutrient_tablet_container_desc: A bottle containing hydroponic nutrient tablets
item_nutrient_tablet_container_flavor: Do Not Consume. For hydroponic use only.
item_kotton_fabric_desc: Used in chemistry to strain large particles from liquids. Far too coarse for water purification.
item_kotton_fabric_flavor: A versatile fabric made of organic fibers. Commonly used for reinforced workwear and shock-insulating wraps.
item_water_filter_desc: Slightly improves water purity when used inside a filter system. Ineffective above a certain threshold.
item_hydroreed_filter_desc: Remove certain type of contaminants when used inside a filter system
item_hydroreed_filter_flavor: A biological filter grown from Hydroreed.
item_lottery_ticket_desc: The winning numbers are revealed each Saturday morning.
item_lottery_ticket_flavor: A jackpot ticket could buy you a lifetime in the Upper Levels' safety and comfort.
item_lottery_ticket_old_desc: A worthless ticket from the Lower Levels Lottery. No winning numbers, just faded hope.
item_lottery_ticket_old_flavor: A jackpot ticket could buy you a lifetime in the Upper Levels' safety and comfort.
item_neuroactive_perfume_desc: Use to boost trading bonus by 15% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time.
item_neuroactive_perfume_flavor: Developed from grief therapy research, this perfume use adaptive scent-mapping tech to evoke positive personal memories. Common in high-end hospitality venues, where workers found that the tips earned by wearing the perfume more than make up for the price tag.
item_pheromone_perfume_desc: Use to boost trading bonus by 25% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time.
item_pheromone_perfume_flavor: An illegal fragrance formulated from engineered human pheromones. It pushes attraction and emotional receptivity. Despite being illegal, it is highly sought after by social climbers in the Upper Levels.
item_screwdriver_flavor: The humble screwdriver, a common fixture of the spare drawers of citizens in the Upper and Lower Levels alike.
item_screwdriver_desc: While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Screws.
item_welder_flavor: High frequency ignition plasma cutter. Manufactured for guaranteed stability, and a fast, strong and smooth cut.
item_welder_desc: Can be used to salvage Scrap Metal by disassembling broken machines. While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Scrap Metal.
item_wire_cutter_flavor: Spring action ensures good leverage and reduces strain on the user, while the soft rubber handles give good grip and comfort.
item_wire_cutter_desc: Can be used to salvage Wire by disassembling broken machines. While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Wire.
item_xray_scanner_desc: Can be use to see what's inside sealed containers.
item_labeler_desc: Used to edit the label of an item.
item_magnifier_desc: Used to inspect certain items more closely.
item_sign_water_desc: A neon sign that, when placed in the Display Case, will attract customers willing to sell Water.
item_sign_expedition_desc: Place it in the display case to attract new hirelings for hire and current hirelings ready for expedition.
item_turbo_booster_desc: A tool that can immediately power machines that require time to operate. Ensure the target machine has all the necessary inputs before using. Consumed upon use.
item_turbo_booster_adv_desc: A tool that can immediately power machines that require time to operate. Ensure the target machine has all the necessary inputs before using. Recharges over time. This advanced version will not be consumed upon use.
item_backpack_small_desc: A compact, well-worn backpack with reinforced stitching. Lightweight but roomy enough for essential supplies.
item_backpack_medium_military_desc: A heavy duty backpack designed for military use. The fabric are very durable and some soldier wear it in the front to use it as additional armor when in battle.
item_backpack_large_military_desc: A heavy duty backpack designed for military use. The fabric are very durable and some soldier wear it in the front to use it as additional armor when in battle.
item_sec_box_desc: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Security Armory. Full of supplies. Access card required.
item_eng_box_desc: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Engineering Foundry. Full of supplies. Access card required.
item_eng_box_flavor: Those hard hats will regret losing their tools...
item_med_box_desc: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Medical Bay. Full of supplies. Access card required.
item_med_box_flavor: Surely these missing supplies won't cost anyone their lives... right?
item_evidence_box_flavor: There's enough here to put the entire Lower Levels behind bars.
item_evidence_box_desc: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Security Evidence Locker. Valuable. Access card required.
item_service_box_desc: A secure crate. Labeled for the Station Service Department. Full of supplies. Access card required.
item_service_box_flavor: The Station Service Department distributes utility supplies to those who need, or pay, for them.
item_internal_springs_desc: A set of advanced internal springs that improve the cycling and resistance to failure under stress.
item_trigger_group_desc: A trigger group that improves the trigger pull. Reduces trigger pull weight and creep.
item_match_barrel_desc: A high precision barrel that improves accuracy.
item_pistol_switch_desc: A special handgun mod. When installed, it alters the internal mechanics so that the gun fires continuously as long as the trigger is held down.
item_ammo_display_desc: A smart display that shows the current ammo count and ammo type.
item_grip_gel_desc: Bio-reactive gel under grip surface conforms subtly to user's hand.
item_rds_desc: A legacy compact red dot sight for quick target acquisition.
item_rds_makeshift_desc: A 3D printed RDS with a red LED and plastic lens. It is not very reliable, but it works surprising well.
item_silencer_desc: A simple multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire, making it harder to detect.
item_silencer2_desc: A sophisticated multi-caliber suppressor that reduces the noise of gunfire, making it harder to detect.
item_silencer_makeshift_desc: A makeshift suppressor made from a plastic bottle and scrap metal.
item_barrel_desc: A multi-caliber extended barrel that improve bullet velocity and accuracy.
item_compensator_desc: A muzzle device that reduce muzzle rise when firing by redirecting escaping gases
item_laser_desc: A simple laser sight that projects a beam onto the target, improving ergonomic.
item_laser2_desc: A smart tactical device that projects a beam onto the target based on various conditions.
item_laser_toy_desc: A low powered toy laser pointer.
item_bipod_desc: A bipod that can be attached to firearms, providing stability.
item_mag_10mm_smg_desc: A 20 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.
item_mag_10mm_smg_high_desc: A 35 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.
item_mag_10mm_smg_box_desc: A 150 round 10mm magazine specially made for the Peacemaker Heavy SMG.
item_mag_22_desc: A cheap 3D printed 12 round compact .22 magazine.
item_stock_desc: A sturdy stock compatible with Meridian firearms, designed to improve recoil handling.
item_short_stock_desc: A short stock compatible with Meridian firearms, designed to improve recoil control without sacrificing ergonomic.
item_common_chemical_desc: Can be unpacked into items that are useful for basic chemical crafting.
item_common_chemical_flavor: A collection of common chemical supplies you could likely find in the Station Hardware Depot.
item_restricted_chemical_desc: Can be unpacked into items that are useful for advanced chemical crafting.
item_restricted_chemical_flavor: A collection of restricted chemical supplies needed for crafting narcotics, or explosives.
item_common_medical_flavor: A collection of common medical supplies, mostly over-the-counter pharmacy items.
item_restricted_medical_flavor: A collection of restricted medical supplies, necessary for the care of the Station's infirm.
item_scrap_metal_desc: Can be smelted into Metal Ore. With limited resources available on the Station, salvage and recycling are important habits.
item_junk_flavor: Broken scraps and useless rubbish. Barely recyclable, worth next to nothing.
item_common_electronic_flavor: An assortment of all kinds of useful, if common, electronics: connectors, switches, capacitors, processors and processing units...
item_rare_electronic_flavor: An assortment of uncommon, high-end electronic parts. A certain inventor would be very interested in this...
item_wire_desc: A bundle of electrical wires. From the looks of it, it was harvested from somewhere...
item_printer_plastic_desc: A spool of premium filament for use in a 3D printer. Made from recycled plastics where possible.
item_gun_part_desc: Obtained from disassembling firearm with a screwdriver. Can be used to refurbish used firearms. Repeated attempts will increase refurbish chance.
item_gun_part_flavor: A collection of internal gun parts, including screws, springs, and other small components.
item_nuclear_waste_desc: Radioactive waste material. Handle with care.
item_nuclear_waste_flavor: A collection of hazardous nuclear waste. No one wants to deal with this stuff.
item_flux_agent_desc: A useful additive that improves the purity of Metal Ore when used during smelting. It is consumed in the process.
item_advanced_flux_agent_desc: A useful additive that improves the purity of Metal Ore when used during smelting. Reusable.
item_printed_gun_desc: A low cost plastic 3D printed pistol.
item_printed_gun_flavor: Doesn't get cheaper than this. It's good for a few shots.
item_handmade_pistol_desc: A small open-sourced pistol chambered in .22 SR
item_handmade_pistol_flavor: Widely used for home defence in the Lower Level. Mostly tolerated by Security. Probably handmade by a Lower Level gunsmith.
item_heavy_handmade_pistol_desc: A heavy open-sourced pistol chambered in 10mm
item_heavy_handmade_pistol_flavor: Capable of piercing body armor. A popular weapon for Lower Level Revolutionary.
item_glock_receiver_desc: A reliable handgun, chambered in 10mm. Mostly carried by Security
item_smg_desc: A heavy SMG, chambered in 10mm. Used sparingly by Security during high stakes operations.
item_shotgun_desc: A dependable and adaptable shotgun built for law enforcement, featuring a dual-action mechanism that ensures reliable performance with a wide range of ammunition types.
item_stun_gun_flavor: A well made self-defence option officially endorsed by Security. Mostly used by Upper Level due to high cost.
item_revolver_desc: A 5" general purpose Lancewell revolver chambered in .45 AFP.
item_revolver_flavor: A simple and highly reliable weapon. Designed to endure extreme conditions, while requiring minimum maintenance.
item_small_pistol_ammo_flavor: A handful of .22 SR ammo. While small, it still can be lethal at close range. Most importantly, it is very cheap.
item_small_pistol_ammo_p_flavor: A handful of .22 SR Armor-Piercing ammo. Capable of piercing body armor.
item_small_pistol_ammo_nl_flavor: A handful of .22 SR Non-Lethal ammo. Tip with rubber, it is designed to incapacitate.
item_heavy_pistol_ammo_flavor: A handful of 10mm ammo. Powerful and reliable, it is the standard round for heavy pistols.
item_heavy_pistol_ammo_p_flavor: A handful of high velocity 10mm Armor-Piercing Discarding Sabot (APDS) ammo. Capable of piercing body armor.
item_heavy_pistol_ammo_nl_flavor: A handful of 10mm Non-Lethal ammo. Tip with rubber, it is designed to incapacitate.
item_tazer_flavor: A compact stun weapon used for self-defense and enforcement. Delivers a painful jolt.
item_birth_control_pill_flavor: A contraceptive pill that prevents pregnancy. It's a combination of estrogen and progestin hormones.
item_phagimycin_pill_flavor: A powerful antibiotic made with bacteriophages and fungi to counter antibiotic resistance.
item_unlicensed_phagimycin_pill_flavor: A powerful antibiotic. This one is made illegaly without license to the carmicheal's patent in an underground lab.
item_zyanide_pill_desc: A fast-acting and deadly chemical compound. Handle with caution.
item_fanta_pill_desc: An extremely addictive, dangerous and cheap synthetic opioid drug used for treatment of severe pain.
item_fanta_pill_flavor: More than 50 times stronger than Oxymore.
item_zerochew_desc: A tab of ZeroChew, an affordable appetite suppressant.
item_zerochew_flavor: Used by some Lower Levels inhabitants looking to stretch their credits by skipping meals. Marketed as Regime-X, a weight loss drug in the Upper Levels.
item_smelling_salt_desc: A thin glass tube containing alcohol and ammonia that helps restore consciousness after fainting.
item_blood_bag_desc: A 500ml blood transfusion bag drawn from a universal, though not necessarily willing, donor.
item_blue_blood_bag_desc: An injectable biogel engineered to dissolve arterial plaque and microclots over time. It effectively prevents coronary artery disease, ischemic stroke and hypertension-related complications.
item_blue_blood_bag_flavor: It's not actually blood. Not so common even in the Upper Levels.
item_dream_dust_flavor: A cheap, euphoria inducing powder, created in the Lower Levels. Used as a brief escape from the harsh realities of Station life.
item_nightmare_dust_flavor: A fine powder that acts as both a poison and a hallucinogen. Ingestion or inhalation causes severe nausea, weakness, and disorientation, followed terrifying hallucinations. High doses can be lethal.
item_caffeine_pill_flavor: Synthesized from the waste of Upper Levels espresso bars, these pills are essential for the long shift workers of the Lower Levels.
item_salve_flavor: Made from modified aloe and medical grade honey. This salve has antibacterial properties and promotes cell regeneration and growth.
item_rubbing_alcohol_flavor: A potent disinfectant used for cleaning wounds and surfaces. Highly toxic if ingested, but that doesn't stop it being used as an alternative to Nudka in the Lower Levels.
item_bandage_desc: A simple, clean bandage for dressing wounds.
item_hemostatic_bandage_desc: A bandage coated with a potent hemostatic agent capable of stopping heavy and light bleeding.
item_topical_bandage_desc: A bandage coated with a mild topical medical gel that aids in the healing process.
item_large_purple_injector_desc: A high-precision immuno-regulator developed to temporarily suppress the hyper-reactive immune response associated with Sentinel Collapse.
item_black_injector_desc: Next-generation treatment for drug addiction, designed to suppress the brain's reward system, reduce cravings, and support long-term recovery
item_black_injector_flavor: Works best with concurrent psychological therapy and social support.
item_pink_injector_desc: Oxymore is a legal, but dangerous medication used to relieve severe pain and produce feelings of euphoria. Oxymore addiction and overdose are widespread due to over-prescription.
item_pink_alt_injector_desc: A non-addictive alternative to Oxymore for pain relief. Provides effective analgesia without the risk of dependence or overdose. This one is a prototype packaged in a repurposed injector.
item_pure_white_injector_desc: Naloxgone is a emergency medication used to counter Oxymore overdose.
item_chem_scanner_desc: A device used to analyze the chemical composition of substances.
item_glass_shard_shiv_flavor: A sharp-edged piece of broken glass wrapped in cloth that can be used as a weapon.
item_combat_knife_flavor: A fighting knife designed for military use and primarily intended for hand-to-hand or close combat fighting, but also useful for utility.
item_box_cutter_flavor: A sturdy utility knife with a retractable blade commonly used in construction, crafting and warehouse work.
item_kitchen_knife_flavor: A stainless steel knife. Keep out of reach of children and scheming Upper Levels Housewives.
item_combat_machete_flavor: A heavy-duty machete built for combat and survival.
item_crowbar_flavor: The trusty tool of every experienced scavenger and theoretical physicist on the Station. Useful as a weapon in a pinch.
item_hatchet_desc: Small but sturdy. Can be used on a Hydroponic Farm to clear whatever is currently growing.
item_pipe_weapon_desc: A heavy lead pipe. After the Station overhauled the water line, tonnes of leftover lead piping found its way into the hands of scavs and thieves.
item_stun_baton_desc: Standard-issue stun baton with STUN and HARM modes. An everyday carry for Security Officers maintaining order in the station.
item_energy_credit_flavor: In an effort to reduce waste, single-use batteries were made illegal by the Republic.
item_energy_credit_desc: A basic power source that is compatible with most machines. Rechargeable.
item_energy_credit_ext_flavor: Improving on the standard model, the Mk. II cell is bigger, better and even more of a choking hazard.
item_energy_credit_ext_desc: An improved power source that is compatible with most machines. Rechargeable.
item_energy_credit_breeder_desc: An advanced and rare energy cell capable of self charging
item_intel_sec_flavor: A copy of your security record file from the Security Department
item_intel_sec_desc: Your contact will keep this up to date
item_flashlight_desc: A heavy duty flashlight. While carrying this, you are less likely to be injured while scavenging in the Dumping Grounds.
item_tutorial_book_desc: A book for keeping track of all notes givien to you by The Mentor. Handy!
item_cigarette_guide_desc: A guide that helps identify counterfeit Hemingway Cigarettes.
item_fuel_guide_desc: A guide for determining the appropriate value of Plasma Cartridges.
item_ribwich_guide_desc: A handy guide that helps with determining the correct value of a Ribwich.
item_stamp_guide_desc: A handy guide to identifying a genuine Food Stamp from a counterfeit.
item_injector_guide_desc: Contains all the information you need to reliably assess the condition of Immunivax Injectors.
item_water_guide_desc: A handy manual that contains all the information on buying and selling Water.
item_hydroponic_guide_desc: A handy manual that contains all the information on hydroponic farming.
item_chemistry_guide_desc: A handy manual that contains the basics of chemistry.
item_logo_checker_desc: A reference for the Official Republic Logo.
item_mentor_contract_desc: Your lease. Signed by you, and your Landlord.
item_business_permit_desc: A permit issued by the Republic. Required to legally operate a business in the Lower Levels.
item_handnote_desc: A simple note, written by hand.
item_scav_token_desc: A token given by the Scavenger community. Each token placed in the display case will increase the chance of a Scavenger visit.
item_dossier_desc: Can hold documents, notes, books and magnifying glasses.
item_trashcan_desc: Items inside will be permanently removed at night if Janitorial Service is paid.
item_drain_desc: Unwanted water can be dump here
item_faucet_desc: No water... Maybe someone can help connect it to a water line?
item_cmd_keycard_flavor: A master keycard, to be carried only by Station Command.
item_cmd_keycard_desc: A single-use keycard for Station Command. Can open most locks that require keycard access.
item_sec_keycard_flavor: Could be dangerous if this falls into the wrong hands...
item_sec_keycard_desc: A single-use keycard for Station Security. Can open locks that require Security Department access.
item_sci_keycard_flavor: Keycard carried by the Station's Research Officers. Valuable.
item_sci_keycard_desc: A single-use keycard for Research and Development. Can open locks that require Science Department access.
item_med_keycard_flavor: A single-use keycard for the Station's Medical Department. Can open locks that require Medical access.
item_eng_keycard_flavor: A single-use keycard for the Station's Engineering Department. Can open locks that require Engineer access.
item_sup_keycard_flavor: A single-use keycard for the Station's Supply Department. Can open locks that require Supply access.
item_ser_keycard_flavor: A single-use keycard for the Station's Service Department. Can open locks that require Service access.
item_blank_keycard_flavor: As close to a skeleton key as you'll find on the Station.
item_blank_keycard_desc: An unwritten keycard. With the right machine, this can be reprogrammed with all kinds of access.
item_card_mining_flavor: No one really know what GP stands for anymore.
item_card_pharma_flavor: A very plain card with only a name and a phone number.
item_card_chem_flavor: It really is just a piece a paper with a phone number on it.
item_card_rev_flavor: A simple green business card with a phone number on it.
item_permit_gun_1_desc: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 0.
item_permit_gun_1_flavor: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade low level contraband firearms and ammunition.
item_permit_gun_2_desc: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 30.
item_permit_gun_2_flavor: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade mid level contraband weapons.
item_permit_gun_3_desc: Increases the chance of gun buying customers to visit while in the display case. This permit will be revoked if Security Reputation is below 60.
item_permit_gun_3_flavor: A permit issued by the Warden allowing the holder to legally own and trade high level contraband weapons.
item_sec_slip_desc: A slip given by the Security Department after responding to an incident.
item_canister_mbs_desc: A highly toxic chemical weapon designed to disrupt the nervous system. Symptoms include: Respiratory failure, Convulsions, Loss of bodily functions, Unconsciousness and Death.
item_food_stamp_desc: Redeem it at the Commissary to buy Food.
item_food_stamp_flavor: A prepaid card valid only to buy groceries. Part of a benefit program to assist the less fortunate in the Lower Levels.
item_cert1_flavor: Certifies you as a junior appraiser.
item_cert1_desc: Place it in the display case to attract customers needing appraisal service to visit.
item_ribwich_desc: A shelf stable limited edition sandwich consists of a restructured boneless pork patty shaped like a miniature rack of ribs. It has a cult following.
item_scratcher_desc: Scratch off at least 2 matching symbols to win a prize!
item_scratcher_flavor: A popular form of gambling in the Lower Levels. It is banned in the Upper Levels.
item_scratcher_stack_desc: Make sure to have enough space before unpacking it.
item_scratcher_stack_flavor: A stack of five lottery scratch cards.
item_plasma_fuel_desc: A compact, solid-state fuel cartridge used in Pulse Plasma Drives for space travel. Value varies wildly depending on the quality of the cartridge.
item_makeshift_storage_bay_desc: A improvised storage bay for storing items. Can't store other containers or machines.
item_storage_bay_desc: A standard bay for storing items.
item_storage_bay_large_desc: An expanded bay for storing items.
item_storage_bay_gun_desc: A specialized storage bay for storing firearms and modifications. Can't store other containers or machines.
item_storage_bay_chem_desc: A specialized storage bay for storing chemistry equipments and supplies. Can't store other containers or machines.
item_machine_bay_desc: A standard bay for storing machines.
item_machine_bay_ext_desc: A expanded bay for storing machines.
item_smuggler_bay_desc: A small disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection.
item_smuggler_bay_mod_desc: A disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection. This one has been modified to allow for more storage.
item_smuggler_bay_mini_desc: A disguised storage bay designed to hide its contents from inspection. This one is mini.
item_powerblock_flavor: A compact power source that can charge adjacent Energy Cells.
item_powerblock_desc: Restores +2 power each night to adjacent Energy Cells, or Energy Cells inside adjacent Machines (excluding Recharger) as long as the Power Service is paid. This effect can be stacked.
item_blank_module_desc: A blank module. With the right machine, this could rewrite this into something useful.
item_system_module_ruined_desc: A completely ruined module. Still holds some value as salvage. Can be broken down with a Screwdriver.
item_system_module_corrupt_desc: A corrupted module. Can be restored with Electronic parts... and a little know-how.
item_system_uncapped_neural_core_desc: High-performance, but unstable, and illegal. An AI core housed inside a system module. These type of AI core have a tendency to go rogue.
item_system_capped_neural_core_desc: AI Cores are illegal onboard the Station. This unit features integrated safeguards that curb rogue behavior, while throttling its performance.
item_crypto_module_cmd_desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Command permissions to Blank Keycards.
item_crypto_module_sec_desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Security permissions to Blank Keycards.
item_crypto_module_med_desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Medical permissions to Blank Keycards.
item_crypto_module_eng_desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Engineering permissions to Blank Keycards.
item_crypto_module_sup_desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Supply permissions to Blank Keycards.
item_crypto_module_ser_desc: A module that allows the Cryptographic Desequencer to write Service permissions to Blank Keycards.
item_printer_chip_desc: A chip that contains the 3D printer blueprint.
item_farm_module_smuggler_desc: A module that remove the contrabands status of any growing seeds.
item_farm_module_hydroreed_filter_desc: A Module that allows the stem of a grown Hydroreed to be harvested and used as a water filter. Does not affect other plants.
item_farm_module_fillerweed_production_d: A module will improve yield of Fillerweed at the cost of losing seeds. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants. This effect is not stackable
item_farm_module_nightmare_cap_desc: A module that concentrate psychoactive propreties of Dream Cap when farming them, turning them into Nightmare Cap, a toxic variant. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.
item_farm_module_dream_cap_desc: A module that neutralize all psychoactive propreties of Dream Cap when farming them, turning them into Meal Cap. This module's unique effect can be stacked but doesn't affect other plants.
item_farm_module_nutrifruit_desc: A module by pastel that allow Hydroponic System to yield more Nutrifruit when farming them. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.
item_farm_module_kotton_loom_desc: A module that wove the Kotton Fiber into a fabric when farming them. This module's unique effect doesn't affect other plants.
item_printer_module_metal_desc: A module that allows the printer to use metal printer chips.
item_alarm_module_transmitter_desc: Currently Transmitting To: {0} Transmitting twice to the same faction has no additional effect.
item_alarm_module_transmitter_flavor: This module will transmit security camera footage captured by your cameras to the set faction.
item_furnace_module_blast_desc: A special Module that modifies the Furnace, allowing {0} Materials to create {1} Metal Ingots (at slightly lower purity). Does not stack.
item_furnace_module_junk_desc: A special Module that modifies the Furnace, allowing Junk to be processed into Scrap Metal.
item_module_extractor_desc: Allows you to extract stuck modules from machines without breaking them. Has {0} uses. Can be partially refurbished with Electronic Parts.
item_module_extractor_advanced_desc: Allows you to extract stuck modules from machines without breaking them. This advanced model will not degrade with use.
item_module_bay_expansion_kit_desc: A one time use kit that will allow you to expand Machine's Module capacity. This kit is not compatible with Chemical or other special Machines.
item_chem_module_desc: Require a module extractor to remove once installed. A special module that can improve the Blender, the Heating Plate and the Chem Finisher
item_node_desc: A specialized circuit that can provide or receive bonuses from adjacent Modules when installed in certain Machines.
item_expedition_box_desc: Put supplies and equipments in this box for your hireling to use during expeditions. Unused gear will be returned to you.
item_armor_lining_desc: Kotton fabric made into padding. Provide modest protection to its wearer. Can protect against small arms if multiple layers are stacked.
item_armor_lining_flavor: Designed for workers in hazardous environment. Also an essential piece of equipment for scavs.
module_effect_remove_contraband: Remove Contraband Status of Growing Seeds
module_effect_blast_furnace:
Increased Input Used 
 -Increased Output Per Night
 -Decreased Purity
module_effect_fillerweed_yield:
Fillerweed will no longer yield seeds 
 -Fillerweed yield +{0}
module_effect_nightmare_cap: Farmed Dream Cap will be Nightmare Cap
module_effect_kotton_fabric: Produce Kotton Fabric instead of Kotton Fiber
item_processed_milk_flavor: A carton of processed milk, or rather, a sweet, carbonated 'milk-based' beverage. Tastes better than you'd expect.
item_processed_juice_desc: A carton of processed juice. All the natural sugars have been extracted and replaced with refined sugars. Contains 0.1% real fruit juice!
item_processed_meat_desc: A can of salty processed meat made by Davre. It is cheap, available and filling. As long as one does not care about what type of meat it is made of.
item_bottled_water_premium_desc: A sealed bottle of water supposedly drawn from a natural spring on a distant planet untouched by any industrial activity.
item_bottled_water_premium_flavor: No one in the Lower Levels would drink this, even if they were dying of thirst, such is its value.
item_red_beer_flavor: A popular beer brewed in the Lower Levels. Every batch tastes a bit different, but there is nothing cheaper. 3.5% ABV.
item_empty_beer_bottle_desc: Not a drop left. To prevent waste, brewers typically offer some kind of "buyback" program for their bottles.
item_med_bottle_red_desc: Can be used to clump Protein and Stabilizing Agent for easier filtering. Also counteracts bases.
item_med_bottle_blue_desc: Can be used to clump Protein and Stabilizing Agent for easier filtering. Also counteracts acid.
item_med_bottle_violet_desc: A versatile chemical base used in many legitimate chemical manufacturing but also a common precursor for Phanta.
item_med_bottle_orange_flavor: Donates electrons to another substance, changing the other substance's chemical state.
item_med_bottle_small_pink_desc: Clump Oils and Fat together allowing them to be filtered off easily. This agent can then be evaporate off.
item_1ml_dropper_flavor: A high-precision dropper for dispensing small amount of liquid.
item_soda_red_desc: A sweet carbonated beverage. On some parts of the Station, it's cheaper than clean water.
item_nudka_desc: A strong spirit made from Nutrifruit. Originally developed to be a heavy-duty paint stripper.
item_galaxy_blend_flavor: A nutritious puree made from pastel Inc.'s Nutrifruit and fortified with additional vitamins and minerals. One of the healthiest, and least popular foods available in the Lower Levels.
item_cat_bar_flavor: A chocolate-covered wafer bar. Made to share, mostly eaten alone.
item_li_eat_snackbar_desc: A high protein chocolate flavored candy bar.
item_small_raw_meat_desc: A small piece of raw meat.
item_small_raw_meat_flavor: Fresh meat is a rare sight in the Lower Levels, where it comes from is of little interest to them.
item_raw_meat_flavor: Fresh meat is a rare sight in the Lower Levels, where it comes from is of little interest to them.
item_fat_meat_desc: A pound of suet. Cheap, and commonly used for rendering into tallow, or adding flavor to broths.
item_meat_scrap_desc: Organs, entrails, cartilage and trimming. While comestible and nutritious, is considered undesirable by most cuisines.
item_cup_noodle_desc: Contains a single use, flameless heater. Just add water for cooking.
item_cup_noodle_flavor: Artificial Braised Beef Flavored. A certified Lower Levels classic. MSG, white pepper and Sichuan peppercorns give this instant noodle a spicy kick.
item_water_ration_desc: Can be poured into a liquid container for 750ml of Basewater.
item_water_ration_small_desc: Can be poured into a liquid container for 375ml of Basewater.
item_ancient_alien_relics_flavor: Looks like scrap metal... "Ancient Alien" scrap metal?
item_scav_journal_flavor: Here I am, deep in the Abandoned Sections. Everywhere else on the station has been picked clean, but this place... it's different. I've heard the stories, but so far, the loot's been good. Still, there's an eerie weight in the air, like something unseen is lurking just out of sight.
item_security_alarm_flavor: A smart security alarm system, equipped with a suite of sensors and connects to cameras installed by the previous owner.
item_security_alarm_desc: Greatly reduces the chance of theft during the night. Requires a dedicated power source to function.
item_alarm_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Prevention Rate Bonus
  Quality: No Effect
item_chem_finisher_desc: Package chemicals into pills, vials and other containers.
item_desequencer_flavor: Can be used to write various permissions to Blank Keycards.
item_desequencer_desc: Requires a Desequencer Chip and an Access Keycard. Requires Energy. Overnight.
item_desequencer_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Speed
  Quality: No Effect
Insert a Desequencer Chip, and an Access Keycard. Requires Energy. Overnight.
item_evaporator_desc: A slow machine that works overnight to evaporate liquids out of a solution using low heat and dry air.
item_evaporator_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Volume Evaporate Per Night
  Quality: Volume of Vapor Captured
Works overnight when power and a water container are provided.
item_furnace_desc: Refines 2 pieces of either metal scrap or ores into a metal ingot. Requires Energy. Overnight.
item_furnace_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: No Effect
  Quality: Maximum Purity
item_furnace_instruction_short: Insert (2) Metal Ore or Scrap Metal to produce (1) Metal Ingot. The quality of the ingot is determined by the purity of the materials used. Using ore results in a higher purity than scrap. Overnight.
item_heating_plate_desc: A shabby looking underpowered and inaccurate heating plate.
item_bottle_printer_flavor: A pre-programmed 3D printer that is capable of creating small Water Bottles.
item_recharger_desc: A device for recharging Energy Cell. Will slowly recharge an Energy Cell as long as the power service has been paid. Overnight.
item_mirage_projector_flavor: A sophisticated device that emits captivating holographic projections, making your Store more attractive to customers.
item_mirage_projector_desc: Requires a night to charge, but improves the street attractiveness of your Store on the next day.
item_projector_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance (0.25 Ratio): Attractiveness
  Quality (0.5 Ratio): Attractiveness
item_3d_printer_desc: A machine that can print various items using plastic. Works overnight.
item_3d_printer_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Printer Speed Rate
  Quality (0.25 Ratio): Print Quality On Eligible Items
item_3d_printer_instruction_short: Insert power source, printer chip and materials. Printer will work automatically overnight if requirements are met.
item_hydroponic_desc: A compact hydroponic system. Requires a dedicated power source to function. Works overnight.
item_hydroponic_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance  (0.5 Ratio): Growth Rate
  Quality (0.5 Ratio): Max Yield %
item_hydroponic_instruction_short: Insert a water container with the cleanest water you can get, a seed, and a power source with enough energy. The hydroponic works overnight. This machine can accept optional modules to improve its capabilities.
item_moisture_farm_flavor: A machine designed to extract Water from the humid ambient air of the Station.
item_moisture_farm_desc: Produces Water when provided with a container. Requires Energy. Overnight.
item_moisture_farm_instruction_short: This machine produces Water by harvesting it from the atmosphere, and deposits it into a provided container. Requires a power source with enough energy. This is an overnight process. This machine can be improved with Modules.
item_moisture_farm_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Volume Produced
  Quality: Purity
item_water_purifier_flavor: A machine that uses reverse osmosis to purify Water.
item_water_purifier_desc: Purifies the contents of an inserted Water container. Requires Energy. Overnight.
item_water_purifier_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Amount Removed Per Night
  Quality (0.5 Ratio): Maximum Purity
item_water_purifier_instruction_short: This machine purifies Water inside a provided container. Significantly more effective for highly contaminated Water. Requires a power source with enough energy. This is an overnight process. This machine can be improved with Modules.
item_vending_machine_flavor: A vending machine that sells items automatically overnight.
item_vending_machine_desc: Items will be sold at +10% additional value and with Retail Markup if applicable but is not affected by event related modifiers.
item_vending_fountain_flavor: A vending water fountain machine that sells water automatically overnight. Only Basewater, High Quality Water and Pure Water can be sold.
item_vending_fountain_desc: Items will be sold at +10% additional value and with Retail Markup if applicable but is not affected by event related modifiers.
item_used_water_testing_strip_desc: A used water quality testing strip.
item_nutrifruit_desc: Created by pastel Inc., the Nutrifruit is a highly modified tuber that is resistant to pests and diseases. It is cheap, has a high yield and is easy to grow, extremely nutritious, but purposefully seedless.
item_kotton_fiber_desc: A modified variant of traditional Cotton. Can be woven into highly durable and versatile fabric
item_nutrifruit_seed_desc: A tuber, genetically modified to be hardy and fast growing. Requires nutrients and water to grow.
item_kotton_seed_desc: A hard to grow seed that can be planted to grow more Kotton Fiber. It is a modified Cotton that can be woven into a durable fabric.
item_dream_cap_desc: Cause a slight euphoria and stomach pain when consumed. A key ingredient in Dream Dust
item_nightmare_cap_desc: Highly poisonous variant of the common Dream Cap. Can be processed into a deadly poison. Survivors report having horrible hallucinations after ingesting it.
item_plant_analyser_desc: A specialized tool that can be used to analyse the growth of plants. It can be used to determine the optimal growing conditions for a plant.
item_fillerweed_seed_desc: A beginner-friendly, fast-growing seed that is not affected by nutrient or water quality.
item_fillerweed_desc: A fast-growing, yellowish leafy crop cultivated primarily in the Lower Levels. Offers almost no nutritional value, it is used as a filler in meals to stretch rations
item_fillerweed_flavor: Has a mushy texture with a slightly bitter aftertaste.
item_hydroreed_seed_desc: A utility crops that produce no food. The Hydroreed will purify the water it is in while growing
item_processed_cheese_flavor: Holes are drilled into the cheese for the classic look, whilst also cutting production costs.
husbandry_vacuum_robot_desc: Automatically collects Animal Feces from its surroundings during the night. Can also be activated manually for an immediate cleanup.
husbandry_serum_red_desc: This serum will slightly boost an animal's growth rate, but at the cost of increased hunger and reduced immunity.
husbandry_serum_green_desc: This serum will slightly boost an animal's immunity but at the cost of increased hunger
livestock_feed_dispenser_desc: A machine that blends food into stored calories for livestock.
item_aug_scanner_flavor: An energy hungry electromagnetic field detector fine tuned to pick up on the unique signatures of the Augmentation chip.
item_aug_scanner_desc: Used to confirm the presence of a suspected Aug with 100% accuracy.
item_surgery_tool_flavor: A set of high quality surgery tools.
item_genetic_scanner_desc: Can be toggled on to reveal the full genetic makeup of an animal.
item_sign_generic_desc: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell {0}
husbandry_mouse_trap_flavor: Putting some cheese inside will probably help.
item_hand_guide_desc: A guide for determining the appropriate value of cybernetic hands.
item_hand_flavor: A marvel of biomechanical engineering, designed to mirror the form and function of the hand it replaces.
item_age_well_desc: Accelerates the aging process of certain items inside. Ages items such as Wine and Cheese by an extra day each cycle.
item_age_well_instruction_flavor:
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance: Power Consumption
  Quality: +1 Day age per 125 Quality
Works overnight when power and a finished bottle of wine are provided.
item_wine_bloomberry_desc: A popular alcoholic beverage in both the Upper and Lower Levels. Coaxing a fine vintage out of humble BloomBerries is considered an art.
item_wine_yeast_flavor: A versatile yeast culture with countless uses, from leavening bread to brewing. For winemaking, it speeds up fermentation and improves the quality of the brew.
item_wine_superyeast_flavor: A highly potent, all-purpose yeast culture prized across countless crafts. For winemaking, it dramatically speeds up the fermentation process.
item_wine_yeast_infinite_desc: An infinite source of yeast. Will be returned to inventory when fermentation starts instead of being consumed.
item_wine_yeast_infinite_flavor: A self-sustaining culture vat that continuously regrows its own yeast.
item_wine_bottle_desc: A fancy glass bottle used for fermenting wine. This one has a integrated airlock.
item_wine_berry_flavor: A sweet berry modified for hydroponic growth. While not particularly filling, it's one of few fruits that is accessible in the Lower Levels. Good for making wine.
item_wine_gloomberry_desc: Looks like a Homebrew BloomBerry wine but this one is cheap and mildly carcinogenic.
item_wine_yeast_red_desc: An illegal substance that can be used instead of yeast to cheaply produce mildly carcinogenic wine. Requires only water.
item_water_ration_flavor: A sealed and certified ration of Basewater.
item_water_ration_small_flavor: A sealed and certified ration of Basewater.
item_bloomberry_seed_desc: A perennial bush. It doesn't die after fruiting. Keep its water clean for better bloomberries. Use a hatchet on the planter to clear it.
item_water_filter_adv_desc: Will recover 50 durability at the start of each day.
item_water_filter_adv_flavor: A premium water filter for pitchers used in the Upper Levels. Slowly self-cleans.
item_portable_water_purifier_desc: Use on a water container to bring its contents up to Basewater purity, whatever's in it. It will use 1 durability per 100ml.
item_portable_water_purifier_flavor: A disposable advanced water purifier, common in the Upper Levels. The discarded ones wash up in the Dumping Grounds, still good for a few more pours.
item_black_lamp_desc: When placed in the display case, it signals thieves that this shop fences stolen goods. Your Black Market reputation affects how likely they are to respond.
item_meal_cap_desc: A neutralized Dream Cap with no psychoactive properties. Legal and safe to eat. Cannot be processed into Dream Dust.
item_skinning_knife_flavor: The perfect knife for a veteran rancher.
item_toolbox_desc: Holds tools. Press 1-9 on the keyboard to equip the stored item.
item_fridge_desc: Chills stored drinks overnight. Chilled goods sell for more. Wine and unsealed water are unaffected.
item_beis_icecream_flavor: A delicious treat that is legally categorized as Artificially Flavored Frozen Dairy Product. Somehow it doesn't melt when unrefrigerated.
item_beis_icecream_desc: Can be sold at a higher value when frozen overnight in the fridge.
item_water_pitcher_desc: Holds a water filter to strip some contaminants from the water poured through it.
item_tilapia_flavor: Common farm fish. Grows fast, eats most things and breeds without much help.
item_gutter_tilapia_flavor: A sewer strain of tilapia. Grows slower and makes less meat for its feed, but dirty water does not bother it, and it takes heavy metal and chemical contaminants out of the tank while it lives there.
item_graft_tilapia_flavor: A modified tilapia. Makes less meat for its feed and needs clean water, but its skin can be sterilized and used as a bandage, and its unfertilized roe dresses a wound as it is.
item_graft_tilapia_roe_flavor: Graft tilapia eggs. Thick with the repair protein that makes the skin heal, which is why medics buy them by the clutch.
item_tilapia_skin_graft_desc: Sterilized skin of a graft tilapia. Stops the bleeding and closes a wound.
item_ras_desc: A closed water loop for raising fish. Needs a water tank, power, and filters to keep the water clean.
item_ras_water_tank_desc: The water reservoir of a recirculating aquaculture system.
item_gutterflow_pellet_desc: Pressed gutter sludge. Cheap calories for omnivore fish, not for people.
item_eel_desc: Raised for its luxury fillets, worth far more than any other fish. Does not breed in captivity.
item_electric_eel_desc: A living generator. From adolescent on, it charges its tank's battery and every battery beside the tank each night, more as it grows. Does not breed in captivity.
item_sturgeon_desc: Farmed for caviar. Its eggs can be harvested using surgery tools while the fish is alive, or collected in full at slaughter. Does not breed in captivity.
item_industrial_fish_feed_desc: Mass produced factory-made feed for omnivore and herbivore fish.
item_dna_disk_desc: A blank data disk. A DNA Manipulator can extract a trait onto it.
item_dna_manipulator_desc: Extracts DNA data onto DNA Data Disks and installs a disk's trait on a target. The higher the target's genetic complexity, the lower the chance of success.
item_dna_manipulator_instruction_short: How to use the DNA Manipulator.
item_dna_manipulator_instruction_flavor:
INSTALL: put a written DNA Data Disk in the input slot and the target in the target slot. The target gains the trait. Installing a trait the target already has stacks a rank. Every successful install uses one charge of the disk.
EXTRACT: put a blank DNA Data Disk in the output slot and the target in the target slot. One random trait is copied onto the disk and the target is lost, unless a genetic stabilizer module is installed. A disk already holding a trait the target carries can be used instead of a blank one: the extraction adds uses to it.
Every edit heats the target's genetics. Heat and complexity make the next edit slower and riskier until the target matures. Switch a gene scanner on to read a target's genetics.
MODULES: a genetic stabilizer keeps the target through extraction; the trait filters restrict a random extraction to positive or negative traits; the precision module, once used on a written disk, extracts that trait specifically.
OUTPUT: after each operation the disk is ejected to the output tray. Toggle the machine to keep disks in their slots instead.
[Module Impact]: 
  Efficiency: Power Consumption
  Performance (0.5 Ratio): Operation Speed
  Quality (0.5 Ratio): Success Chance
item_dna_module_stabilizer_desc: Lets the target survive DNA extraction: a trait can be removed without destroying the target.
item_dna_module_positive_filter_desc: Restricts DNA extraction to positive traits. Nothing is extracted from a target that has none.
item_dna_module_negative_filter_desc: Restricts DNA extraction to negative traits. Nothing is extracted from a target that has none.
item_dna_module_precision_desc: Use this module on a DNA Data Disk containing a trait to scan it. When installed in a DNA Manipulator, it will only extract the scanned trait.
item_moisture_farm_desc_shared_air: Running multiple Moisture Farms decreases the output of each.
item_printer_module_melee_batch_desc: A printer module that adds one more weapon to every melee weapon print. Slow and power hungry.
item_gun_frame_desc: An incomplete gun frame, add a gun part on it to finish it.
item_printer_module_cnc_desc: A module that allows the printer to use gun frame and gun part chips, together with the Metal Printing Module.
item_debris_pile_rest_desc: You will spend some time clearing the debris whenever you sleep without going out of the Store.
item_debris_pile_tool_desc: You will need tools to clear this one. Each tool used on it will be destroyed.
item_debris_pile_service_desc: Far too heavy to move yourself. The Debris Removal nightly service will be needed to clear it.
item_makeshift_reactor_desc: Powers the Store while its integrity is above {0}. Loses integrity every night and explodes at 0. Scrap metal restores {1} integrity. Junk restores {2} integrity but lowers maximum integrity by {3}. Each common electronic part reduces the nightly loss by 1.
item_appraisal_cert_flavor: Certifies your rank on the Appraiser Board.
item_current_converter_desc: Draw power directly from the Lower Levels' grid to power any machine instead of a battery. The Current Converter nightly service must be paid in order to receive power.
item_lou_bomb_armed_desc: This is what Lou planted. According to the timer, it will explode at midnight. You'd better disarm it.
item_lou_bomb_fake_desc: This is the bomb Lou planted, but it looks like there's no actual payload inside.
item_lou_old_orders_desc: A yellowed, brittle sheet. It looks like it has been folded and unfolded many times. It's a written order addressed to Lou, dated years ago. A faded Republic seal is still visible at the top.
item_lou_old_orders_flavor:
REPUBLIC JOINT SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMAND, PRIORITY ORDER
TO: Emergency Response Team Leader Lou

Stop stalling for time and carry out this order immediately. Take your team and start the self-destruct sequence of the research ship Icarus. Disable all the escape pods and do not allow any survivor from the Icarus to escape with your team. Do it, or I will have you court-martialed.

(The signature has faded beyond reading.)
item_lou_toy_box_flavor: Looks like a repurposed evidence locker from the Security Department. Better not touch anything inside.
item_liquid_luck_flavor: Will 100% increase your luck for 3 days! Georgio's guarantee! It tastes like Rustwater.
item_internal_springs_improved_desc: A set of sturdier internal springs that help the action cycle reliably.
item_gamblers_coin_flavor: A coin from a currency nobody remembers. They say it brings luck. Mostly, it scratches tickets faster.
item_luxury_supply_crate_desc: A sealed crate of fine goods from the Upper Levels. Whoever packed it spared no expense. Strange, though: your Security feed lists it as reported stolen.
item_self_refilling_perfume_desc: Use to boost trading bonus by 15% with the current customer. You can only benefit from the effects of one perfume at a time. Refills on its own.
item_self_refilling_perfume_flavor: The premium edition of the SYNC perfume. A sealed reservoir in the cap slowly synthesizes a new dose, so the bottle never quite runs dry.
item_storage_bay_expansion_kit_desc: Use it on a Storage Bay to add two storage tabs, or on an Extended Storage Bay to add one.
item_storage_coordinator_desc: Assign containers and machines to presets. Give each preset a hotkey to open them quickly.
item_hypertech_electronic_flavor: The bleeding edge of electronics. Nobody on the station can make these.
item_hypertech_electronic_desc: Used to upgrade or charge certain Hypertech items.
item_hypertech_power_cell_desc: An experimental cell with no stored charge. It powers any machine whose draw stays within the cell's output rating, indefinitely. Machines that draw more than the rating get nothing.
item_turbo_booster_hypertech_desc: A turbo booster powered by an Energy Cell. It charges every cycle and banks spare charge. Once charged, it instantly completes a machine's current cycle.
item_mind_reprogrammer_desc: Can remove and add certain perks. Consume Electronic Parts (Hypertech) to charge it. The device needs time to reset after each use.
item_auto_butcher_desc: A configurable auto butcher. It needs to be installed inside an Animal Cage or a RAS. Every night it harvests the animals that match its settings into its tray. It always ignores animals marked with the Marking Pen.
item_auto_butcher_flavor: The mighty Gibber. Do not climb inside. Do not let anyone help you climb inside.
item_marking_pen_desc: Marks an animal or a fish with a colour. The Auto Butcher never touches a marked animal.
item_intake_hopper_desc: Can be linked to an Outlet Hopper and configured to send the items of its inventory into the Outlet Hopper's inventory every night. Use it on an Outlet Hopper to link them, double-click to set it up.
item_outlet_hopper_desc: Receives the items sent by its linked Intake Hoppers into its inventory every night. Use it on an Intake Hopper to link them, double-click to run them now.
item_energy_credit_dis_desc: A high capacity single-use energy cell. Cannot be recharged.
item_energy_credit_dis_flavor: Favored in the Upper Levels for its convenience.
item_water_tank_desc: A large liquid container. Use scrap metal or a metal ingot on it to enlarge it.
